wins.text: Q1 net inflows of $130B drove 8% organic base fee growth — highest first quarter in 5 years — and 10% over the last 12 months on $744B of net new assets
Revenue of $6.7B grew 27% YoY; operating income of $2.7B up 31%; EPS of $12.53 up 11% YoY
As-adjusted operating margin expanded 130 bps YoY to 44.5%; ex-performance fees margin was 45.6%, up 180 bps YoY
Record Q1 ETF net inflows of $132B with double-digit organic base fee growth; active ETF platform grew 4x in 2 years to $110B+ AUM with $19B of Q1 inflows
Aperio generated a record $13B of net inflows in Q1 (record for 5th straight year); SpiderRock added over $1B; AUM more than tripled and doubled respectively since acquisition

risks.text: Institutional index net outflows of $35B concentrated in low-fee index equities, partially offsetting strong active and private markets inflows
March 2026 was the worst month for broad markets since September 2022 (stocks down 7-10%, bonds down 2-3%), creating AUM headwinds; base fee entry rate at end of March was ~2% lower than Q1 average
Elevated geopolitical uncertainty from Middle East conflict could shift sovereign wealth fund behavior and capital priorities, though no behavioral change observed yet
New activity levels in private credit were somewhat lower in Q1 due to market uncertainty; potential for elevated redemptions and muted subscriptions in wealth channel BDC/evergreen vehicles
EPS growth of 11% lagged revenue/operating income growth of 27-31% due to lower nonoperating income, higher effective tax rate, and higher share count from HPS transaction closing

guidance_items.detail: Long-term organic base fee growth target of 5%+ reaffirmed; management expressed confidence in consistently delivering 6%-8%
45% or greater adjusted operating margin target reaffirmed; recurring FRE margin trajectory toward 50%+ over time
Technology ACV low-to-mid-teens growth target reaffirmed; ACV grew 14% YoY in Q1
Share repurchases of at least $450M per quarter for the balance of 2026, consistent with January guidance
25% effective tax rate projected as reasonable run rate for remainder of 2026

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Potential fee holiday or competitive pricing strategy for the newly filed NASDAQ 100 ETF (IQQ) and cannibalization risk vs. S&P complex
Specific sovereign wealth fund behavioral changes in response to Middle East conflict and Asia energy price pressures
Elevated redemption risk in retail evergreen private credit BDC vehicles and near-term subscription trajectory
